pr_body:
Motivation:

We cant reuse the ChannelPromise as it will cause an error when trying to ful-fill it multiple times.

Modifications:

- Use a new promise and chain it with the old one
- Add unit test

Result:

Fixes https://github.com/netty/netty/issues/10240

comments: By the way , Some `channnel.close()` may be called in the business thread pool which type is DefaultEventExecutorGroup.
Yep that is a bug... looking into it

@timandy we're seeing increase in netty direct byte buffer memory usage go up and in the logs, we're consistently seeing this log message whenever the memory increases. 

Do you by any chance remember how to reproduce this issue?
> The sever has about 20,000 websocket connections with one test client . I shut down the client. Then the error printed many times.

What exactly do you mean by you shut down the client? Do you mean you killed it without sending the Close frame?

I would like to test out whether this error is the reason for our memory increase, maybe this causes a leak somewhere. If it is, then it might be a good case for us to upgrade to the latest version with this issue fixed.

Thanks

> What exactly do you mean by you shut down the client? Do you mean you killed it without sending the Close frame?

Yes, I force killed the client process without sending the close frame. Then the log was printed on server side.
